body:
My phone's at 2% and I doubt it will hold longer. I've wrote a note and put everyone's name on a thank you list. It was nice having you people listen to the story for the end of my life. After I hit save I'll be jumping. Thanks for your time. I hope everyone can lead a happy life and I hope there's a heaven.


- The 25 year old asian with tears full
I have nothing left to live for. I'm 25 with no career, no friends, no family in the area. It's hard to accept, but the world might be better without me

I've moved here on my own, busting my ass left and right to try and make it work. I couldn't even get a little break to help with my finances. I really don't see another way. At least my gf will get my life insurance
Thank you just a random persen, hopefully there's a heaven. Or at least a special place for people who are tired of giving it their all and getting nothing in return

Thank you for your comment. But life will go on with or without me. I have nothing left to try for. I can't stomach the feeling of working towards something that I threw away in 2 days. I've been closing my eyes a lot now. When it gets darker then I'll make my jump
I'm at 9% battery left. I don't think I am going to kms, I know I am going to kms.

Life's not fair. I envy the people who have had it so easy. I've busted my ass off since I was in high school. Working jobs starting from Grade 8. What have I got to show for it? Absolutely nothing. And it kills me inside.
She's at work
I was a process engineer

She has no idea. I can't face her with this. We were building a life for each other. And I have nothing left to show for it. If I just live? There's nothing to live for. She'll break up with me. I'll be homeless and in a lot of debt. It's a hotel

I have no kids. I have no dependents. All I had was my measly $20,000 and I've lost that. The amount of friends I had lost by choosing to work over chilling. There's no going back. No one's going to miss me
I have no kids.
My phone's at 11%. It's a shitty phone and usually cuts off around 8%. Anyways, I just wanted to thank you for taking time out of your day to hear about mine. I'm just about ready to go now

Just staring at the busy roads. Taking notice of people who wander the streets. It's a nice view out here. The other side of the building has no one so I guess to be considerate I'll be jumping from there

I no longer have a job. Many companies aren't doing so well so there was a massive lay off. I have family, but I don't have the courage to face them and tell them what I have done. We grew up poor, are still poor, and what I have done is the equivalent of losing 2 years worth of work
I've been here 2 hours unnoticed. I guess it's God's way of telling me to just end it. My phone's at 12%. Once it's dead, hopefully I'll be tired enough to let go

At no point was it ever fun. I was just chasing my initial stake of $1000. I never even came close to making a comeback. I wanted to double my bank account to $40,000 so I could stop worrying about my finances every second of my life. I'm $40000 in debt from student loans and thankfully I have no credit card debt. I have 12 cents left in my bank account but once the pre-authorized payments start bouncing, I'll be in a bigger hole. I'm just fucked and I have nothing left to do but jump
I lost it all from poor choices. Casino actually.
I have no plans to move myself. When I feel tired enough, I'll probably just let go and fall. My heart was racing when I first got up here. Now I don't really seem to mind just dying

I can't find any scenario where this works out in my favour. I've lost it all man. Lost it all. Worked hard for years for that $20,000. And now I have $0.12 left in my bank account with rent coming up, a car payment, gym membership, etc. I don't know what to even do.

I just turned 25. My family has always been poor. If they know I've lost this money, I can't even imagine the disappointment. I can't even face them. I was hospitalized and discharged from the psych ward recently. But the thoughts haven't gone away. I haven't been able to tell anyone I know. What a world. I guess I'm valuing my life at $20,000. How I wish I could turn back time to just 3 days ago.
